title: Spending limits and safety features for minors
summary: This document details minors’ debit card spending limits and safety controls: $300/day cap on card purchases, $150/day ATM cash withdrawals, and $250/day EveryonePay person-to-person transfers. It also lists alerting at ≥62 and debit card decline codes 57/58/61/62/65 with required resolution steps (e.g., MCC/online/international blocks, terminal flagged, limit calculations, 24-hour temp increases, region locks, and midnight resets).
